reply_text:
The store is **Pine Crossing**. I replied to Pree in a thread on her message in #central-team.

That answer comes from her own message in #central-team on 9 June. She wrote that Pine Crossing's morning receiver could only see the afternoon shift on the appointment screen. A driver had arrived at 7:10 and they wrote his trailer number on a sticky note. Hollis said he'd check the shift template and get support to reproduce the problem. I told her I haven't seen any later message in the channel saying it was fixed.

I only used sources Pree can see herself: channels she's a member of and public team files.
